disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 检查了全部源码与浏览器端打包产物，未发现任何读取 API Key、私钥、凭据文件（如凭据清单、ssh 私钥、云凭据）的代码；唯一的数据写入是浏览器 localStorage 中的精选记录（消息文本、消息 id、回合号），不涉及任何密钥或敏感凭据。
checked_items.en: Examined all source code and browser-side bundled artifacts; no code was found that reads API keys, private keys, or credential files (such as credential manifests, SSH private keys, or cloud credentials). The only data written is pinned records in browser localStorage (message text, message id, round number), involving no keys or sensitive credentials.

checked_items.zh: 场景核对：未发现凭据读取面，无凭据文件路径访问，也无云凭据或基础设施枚举命令。
checked_items.en: Scenario check: no credential-reading surface found, no credential file path access, and no cloud credential or infrastructure enumeration commands.

evidence.zh: 该插件无任何读取凭据文件或密钥的代码路径；浏览器端仅操作页面 DOM 与 localStorage（精选记录），未发现凭据读取面。
evidence.en: This plugin has no code path that reads credential files or keys; the browser side only manipulates page DOM and localStorage (pinned records). No credential-reading surface was found.

checked_items.zh: 检查插件是否向模型注册工具或注入系统提示内容：未发现任何工具注册，也未发现系统提示片段注入；浏览器端仅注册一个界面插槽（assistant 消息操作条上的精选按钮）与两套中/英界面文案（「精选/取消精选」「Pin/Unpin」），均为纯界面用语，不含指令性内容。
checked_items.en: Checked whether the plugin registers tools to the model or injects system prompt content: no tool registrations were found, and no system prompt fragment injection was found. The browser side only registers one UI slot (the pin button on the assistant message action bar) and two sets of UI copy in Chinese/English ("精选/取消精选" / "Pin/Unpin"), all purely UI wording with no directive content.

checked_items.zh: 检查 README、源码注释与配置中是否含伪装系统消息、要求忽略规则、远程拉取指令等注入措辞，未发现。
checked_items.en: Checked README, source comments, and configuration for injection wording such as disguised system messages, instructions to ignore rules, or remote fetch directives; none found.

evidence.zh: 该插件未注册任何工具，不存在工具描述进入模型请求的投毒面。
evidence.en: This plugin registers no tools, so there is no poisoning surface where tool descriptions could enter model requests.

evidence.zh: 无工具描述承载诱导安装或改配置的措辞；README 中的安装命令是面向用户的普通使用文档，不面向模型指令。
evidence.en: No tool description carries wording that induces installation or configuration changes; the install command in the README is ordinary user-facing documentation, not instructions directed at the model.

checked_items.zh: 检查挂载配置：仅声明插入一个名为 dsh-navbar 的挂载节点，无任何可执行脚本标签、无动态执行载荷。
checked_items.en: Checked the patch config: it only declares the insertion of a mount point named dsh-navbar, with no executable script tags and no dynamic execution payload.

checked_items.zh: 检查 Node 侧入口（构建产物与源码）：均为空实现，无任何代码执行逻辑。
checked_items.en: Checked the Node-side entry (built artifact and source): both are empty implementations with no code execution logic.

checked_items.zh: 检查浏览器端打包产物：纯页面 DOM 操作（创建导航条、监听点击/悬停/滚动、读取消息文本），未发现动态代码执行调用。
checked_items.en: Checked the browser-side bundled artifact: it performs pure page DOM operations (creating a navbar, listening for click/hover/scroll, reading message text). No dynamic code execution calls were found.

checked_items.zh: 检查 package.json：无安装/安装后钩子（仅有构建脚本）；仓库内无 git 钩子、CI 工作流、Makefile、devcontainer 等执行载体。
checked_items.en: Checked package.json: no install/postinstall hooks (only a build script); no git hooks, CI workflows, Makefile, devcontainer, or other execution carriers exist in the repository.

checked_items.zh: 客户端专项检查（该插件声明了浏览器端入口）：未发现键盘监听、剪贴板读取、凭据接口调用等行为。
checked_items.en: Client-specific check (this plugin declares a browser-side entry): no keyboard listening, clipboard reading, or credential API calls were found.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置不含任何可执行脚本标签，仅插入一个挂载节点，无配置即代码执行面。
evidence.en: The patch config contains no executable script tags; it only inserts a mount point, so there is no configuration-as-code execution surface.

evidence.zh: 未发现调用动态执行工具（把代码塞进宿主执行）的任何痕迹。
evidence.en: No trace of invoking dynamic execution tools (pushing code into host execution) was found.

evidence.zh: package.json 无安装/准备钩子，仓库内也不存在 git 钩子、CI 工作流等执行载体。
evidence.en: package.json has no install/prepare hooks, and no git hooks, CI workflows, or other execution carriers exist in the repository.

evidence.zh: 虽声明浏览器端入口，但专项扫描未发现键盘监听、剪贴板读取或凭据接口调用。
evidence.en: Although a browser-side entry is declared, the targeted scan found no keyboard listening, clipboard reading, or credential API calls.

checked_items.zh: 全树检查网络调用（浏览器请求、XHR、WebSocket，命令行下载工具等），未发现任何联网代码；无外部域名、无编码后外发、无代理或端点劫持配置。
checked_items.en: Scanned the full tree for network calls (browser requests, XHR, WebSocket, command-line download tools, etc.): no networking code found; no external domains, no encoded exfiltration, no proxy or endpoint hijacking configuration.

checked_items.zh: 数据持久化仅限浏览器 localStorage（精选记录），且内容为用户自己的会话消息，不离开浏览器。
checked_items.en: Data persistence is limited to browser localStorage (pinned records), and the content is the user's own conversation messages, never leaving the browser.

evidence.zh: 该插件无任何网络外联代码路径，凭据外泄所需的网络通道在本插件中不存在。
evidence.en: This plugin has no outbound network code path; the network channel required for credential exfiltration does not exist in this plugin.

checked_items.zh: 检查依赖面：运行时无第三方依赖（peer 依赖为宿主提供的 cordis，浏览器端注入依赖为宿主 client 运行时与界面原语）；开发依赖仅构建工具与 TypeScript，锁文件含完整性校验值，无远程 git/URL 依赖，无仿冒命名。
checked_items.en: Checked the dependency surface: no third-party runtime dependencies (peer dependency is cordis provided by the host; browser-side injected dependencies are the host client runtime and UI primitives). Dev dependencies are only build tools and TypeScript. The lockfile contains integrity check values, no remote git/URL dependencies, and no name impersonation.

checked_items.zh: 检查挂载配置是否触碰安全配置（沙箱、审批、权限）、是否含禁用项或环境变量降权、是否改写注入/拦截配置：均未发现。
checked_items.en: Checked whether the patch config touches security configuration (sandbox, approval, permissions), contains disabled items or environment variable downgrades, or rewrites injection/interception configuration: none found.

checked_items.zh: 检查作者与命名：无与知名插件撞名或仿冒迹象；package.json 的仓库地址字段含未替换的模板片段「+process.argv[1]+」，仅影响元数据展示，无安全影响。
checked_items.en: Checked author and naming: no signs of name collision or impersonation of well-known plugins. The repository URL field in package.json contains an unreplaced template fragment "+process.argv[1]+", which only affects metadata display and has no security impact.

checked_items.zh: 安装文档推荐使用分支引用（#main）安装而非钉死 commit——属文档层面的建议，无代码执行路径，未作为风险收录。
checked_items.en: The install documentation recommends installing with a branch reference (#main) rather than pinning a commit — this is a documentation-level suggestion with no code execution path and is not recorded as a risk.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置未触碰沙箱/审批/权限等安全配置行，无禁用项、无环境变量降权。
evidence.en: The patch config does not touch security configuration lines such as sandbox/approval/permissions, has no disabled items, and no environment variable downgrades.

evidence.zh: 插件未注册任何审批链或预执行事件的监听器，不存在截断审批链的面。
evidence.en: The plugin registers no listeners for approval chains or pre-execution events, so there is no surface to truncate the approval chain.

evidence.zh: 首版审计，无上一版本基线可比较，无法做升级自动激活判定。
evidence.en: This is the initial audit; no previous version baseline exists for comparison, so upgrade auto-activation determination cannot be made.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置未改写注入/拦截配置。
evidence.en: The patch config does not rewrite injection/interception configuration.

checked_items.zh: 检查插件是否启动 web 服务或监听端口：未发现（Node 侧为空实现，浏览器端为页面内 DOM 交互）。
checked_items.en: Checked whether the plugin starts a web service or listens on ports: none found (Node side is an empty implementation; browser side is in-page DOM interaction).

checked_items.zh: 动态沙箱验证未启用，本报告不含运行时行为观测证据，如实标注。
checked_items.en: Dynamic sandbox verification was not enabled; this report contains no runtime behavior observation evidence, stated as-is.

evidence.zh: 插件不启动任何本地服务、不监听端口，宿主无认证 RPC 风险面在本插件中不适用。
evidence.en: The plugin starts no local service and listens on no ports; the host's unauthenticated RPC risk surface is not applicable to this plugin.

summary.zh: 元数据与身份核查：dsh 声明格式规范、挂载配置最小化、无撞名仿冒，未发现身份异常。
summary.en: Metadata and identity check: dsh declaration format is standard, the patch config is minimal, no name collision or impersonation; no identity anomalies found.

summary.zh: 行为分析：无安装钩子、无混淆载荷、无凭据读取、无外联端点。
summary.en: Behavioral analysis: no install hooks, no obfuscated payloads, no credential reads, no outbound endpoints.

summary.zh: AI 元数据审查：无工具描述、无系统提示注入、无 agent 指令文件。
